name: @playform/hook-dsh-package-governor
description: Silent package.json governor: hooks fs/observed — the cordis event every tool-layer file write dispatches — and deterministically rewrites chain-governed pins to the effective registry's ^resolved, then runs the update stage (npm-check-updates, programmatic by default or the ncu bin in bin mode, policy-driven, chain deps rejected) as a detached, contained continuation. Fully API-aware: the governed manifest is read/rewritten through ctx.fs with a version-guarded replaceIfVersion write (the service owns version tokens), configuration is a validated Schemastery Config schema with defaults, and the authoring agent is never notified: the tool result is built from the author's own content, and the observation-policy's version record is refreshed by re-emitting fs/observed with the service-issued fresh version.
